senses.sense_definition: страдательное причастие прошедшего времени от глагола <w>слить</w>

examples.text: Весь бензин был <w>слитый</w> из бака перед ремонтом автомобиля.

target_lang_translations.en: All the gasoline was <w>drained</w> from the tank before the car repair.

examples.text: В стакан был <w>слитый</w> остаток чая из чайника.

target_lang_translations.en: The remaining tea was <w>poured out</w> from the teapot into a glass.

target_lang_definitions.en: Past passive participle of the verb 'to pour out' or 'to drain', indicating that something has been emptied or transferred from one container to another.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: referring to liquid removed from a container
referring to the act of transferring liquid
referring to liquid carefully transferred from one vessel to another
